facts.content: Trial alternate NSAID, regular dosing with food, and can add paracetamol.

facts.content: Advise rest and hydration.
Seek care if worsening pain, new neuro symptoms, fever, rash, vomiting, neck stiffness, recurrent episodes, or not improving in 1–2 days.
facts.source_text: Safety-net: Seek care if worsening pain, new neuro sx, fever, rash, vomiting, neck stiffness, recurrent episodes, or not improving in 1–2 days after meds

facts.content: Call back if not settling in 1–2 days or if recurrent for further evaluation and management.
facts.source_text: Follow-up: Call back if not settling in 1–2 days or if recurrent for further evaluation (incl. BP check) and management
